sentences.text: Revenue compounded at 9.1% a year from FY2016 to FY2025, but the path was a commodity cycle, not a trend [F168].
Revenue fell 58.0% in FY2020 to $13.7 billion, then rose 153.2% in FY2021 and 76.5% in FY2022 to $61.0 billion [F5][F6][F7][D161][D200][D238].
The FY2022 jump came mainly from higher realized commodity prices and higher sales volumes, primarily from the Shell Permian acquisition [P59].
The FY2023 reversal, a 20.5% revenue decline, was driven by lower realized commodity prices partly offset by higher sales volumes [F8][D274][P47].
Since then revenue has flattened, up 1.8% in FY2024 and 4.9% in FY2025, while net income fell 24.7% a year over FY2022 to FY2025 [D308][D342][D845].
The U.S. is the franchise: 79.1% of FY2025 revenue, contributing 5.7pp of the 4.9% growth [D382][D384][D342].
Lower 48 alone was 70.2% of FY2025 revenue and contributed 8.0pp of growth, so the portfolio is concentrated in one region [D711][D713].
FY2025 sales and other operating revenues rose $4.2 billion on higher volumes of $6.2 billion, including Marathon Oil volumes, partly offset by lower crude and bitumen prices [P28].
Profit did not keep pace: net income fell 13.6% in FY2025 against 4.9% revenue growth, and EPS fell 18.7% [D343][D342][D344].
The diluted share count rose 6.1% in FY2025, so per-share earnings fell faster than net income [D356][D343][D344].
Net margin was 15.4% in FY2025, below the 17.9% window median and far under the 30.6% FY2022 high [F30][D831][D830].
Cost of revenue rose to 37.9% of revenue from 36.6%, and D&A rose to 19.5% from 17.5% [D326][D292][D330][D296].
DD&A increased $1.9 billion in FY2025, primarily from the Marathon Oil acquisition and higher production volumes [P22].
SG&A fell $265 million, mainly the absence of $545 million of Marathon transaction expenses, partly offset by restructuring severance [P23].
The effective tax rate rose to 36.9% from 32.4%, widening the gap between operating and net margin [D332][D298].
Operating cash flow was $19.8 billion in FY2025, 2.48x net income and above the 2.07x window median [F59][F20][D333][D855].
The 1.6% decline in operating cash flow came from lower commodity prices, mostly offset by Marathon Oil operations [D346][P6].
Operating cash flow was 33.6% of revenue, and FY2025 capex of $12.6 billion was well above that year's operating cash flow of $19.8 billion [D331][P7][F59].
D&A of $11.5 billion nearly matched that capex, so capital intensity is close to depreciation rather than above it [X61][P7].
Cash and equivalents were $6.5 billion at FY2025, up 15.9%, with a 1.30x current ratio [F113][D348][F153].
Net debt cannot be tracked across the window because long-term debt is not reported after FY2020 [F157].
FY2025 uses of cash were $12.6 billion of capex, $5.0 billion of buybacks, $4.0 billion of dividends and $0.9 billion of debt retirement, partly offset by $3.2 billion of asset sales [P7].
Buybacks plus dividends of $9.0 billion were 46% of operating cash flow, above the stated 30% framework [D339][F59][P31].
Revenue in the table is a later recast for every year: FY2025 shows $51.8 billion against $58.9 billion as first reported [F10][X10].
Growth and margin comparisons that mix recast and first-reported years are not like-for-like, so the arc above should be read with that caveat [R1].
Long-term debt is missing before FY2017 and after FY2020, so net cash and debt growth cannot be computed across the window [R5][R6].
Short-term investments are missing in FY2021, which distorts cash and investments growth across that year [R7].
Revenue fell 20.5% in FY2023 on lower realized commodity prices, the one genuine top-line contraction outside FY2020 [F8][D274][P47].
Watch net margin against the 17.9% window median; a print below the FY2025 15.4% would extend the compression [D831][F30].
Watch operating cash flow against the FY2025 $19.8 billion; a further decline would confirm the commodity-price drag cited in the FY2025 10-K [F59][P6].
Watch the diluted share count against 1,253.4 million; further growth would keep EPS falling faster than net income [X131][D356].
